title: Love-Brained
text: “School, huh. Sounds like a pretty fun place. Big Bro! Why don’t we do that in this village?”
“We already teach all sorts of things here, don’t we? In a way, this place is school and dormitory and village all in one. It’s not that different.”
“But I wanna study in an actual building called a school, Big Bro!”
“Then go enroll in some country’s school! You’re still young enough to get in!”
Around this time, I found myself vaguely picturing something resembling an academy, drawing on my game knowledge, I say.
“Oh, right! So that means Ark-san’s a man, huh? I got told I’m not allowed in the men’s bath!”
Keel is female, after all. Big Sister and the others have forbidden her from entering the men’s bath. Ark answered Keel’s question with a faint smile, a finger pressed to his lips.
“Now, which do you suppose it is?”
“Eh! Just tell me already! Sniff sniff… I can’t tell at all, there’s no smell whatsoever!”
“Oh my. Keel-chan’s curious too?”
“I wanna be a man too, dammit!”
“Fufufu.”
“Quit being so coy about it. That cat over there doesn’t even have a gender, so— oh, I’m male, by the way. Manliest of men.”
Ho-kun said this in a tone that sounded exasperated with Ark. So the cat had no gender. But Ark was this dragon’s superior—and I’d heard that dragons don’t really have genders to begin with, I say.
“Couldn’t you let me be a little more mysterious about it?”
“No gender, huh… Well, I suppose it makes sense for a superior to be that way, since dragons go around doing their business regardless of gender.”
Father asked Ark somewhat warily, and Ark answered while tilting his head slightly.
“Ah, I don’t have any reproductive capability either. I’m just that sort of existence. Quite different from the dragons of this world.”

So he was a being entirely without such functions, indeed. Still, something about the way Ark laughed, the way he tilted his head while fixing you with that gaze—I was starting to feel it reminded me of someone.
“You seem a bit on guard, but don’t worry. I’m not the type to go playing around like that troublesome bird over there who got abandoned by his wife.”
“Whoa, you’re really going there with me? Harsh. I think you might’ve crossed a line just now.”
“You’re in a good mood, so clearly you don’t care, do you.”
Father looked over at Ho-kun, and then, for some reason, at me.
“Seriously, your world’s just full of love-brained people, isn’t it.”

I felt like I was being treated rather unfairly here! Ho-kun and I were just from the same hometown, so to speak—he just happened to have been in my world once. I really didn’t like the implication that Ho-kun getting abandoned by his wife was somehow because it was my world’s fault!
“That has nothing to do with me, I say! Ho-kun getting abandoned by the one he loved was entirely his own doing, indeed!”
“Wow, Motoyasu-kun, even you’re saying it! But aren’t you the type who gets run away from too?”
“No such thing, indeed! Filo-tan!”
“Yaa!”
Filo-tan answered energetically as always, I say. What a shy one. Military-style! Yaa! Indeed! Yaa!
“How about that!”
“Well, ‘how about that’…”
“No point saying anything. Just give up.”
Father sighed for some reason. Fufufu, one should not underestimate the bond between me and Filo-tan, I say.
“Speaking of men and women, or rather harems—there was a student I taught various things to once, come to think of it.”
“Now what…”

“Oh, nothing sinister. There was this one species, you see, where basically only females are born, and males appear only extremely rarely. So, to preserve the bloodline, whenever a male is born, he’s got a harem of same-species fiancées lined up for the future. Some of the fiancées were apparently as far apart in age as parent and child.”
“Ugh.”
Father made a thoroughly disgusted face. As far apart as parent and child, huh… that certainly sounded like a rough situation, I say.
“That child hated that fate, so during the free period he had, he came to me to figure out how to solve his clan’s problem.”
“And did he manage it?”
“More or less. There were various other curses laid on the clan as a whole, so I helped undo those too. Breaking free from a harem seemed like quite the ordeal.”
“Huh… nicely done, I guess.”
“What a luxurious problem to have. Isn’t a harem every male’s dream?”

Ho-kun muttered this here, I say. I understood the feeling well enough. I too once held such a dream. Father, apparently, once held such a dream as well. But it seemed to me that Father had realized the gap between fantasy and reality after failing to properly imagine handling each individual partner well.
“I mean… you really have seen all sorts of things, haven’t you.”
“Well, when you live as long as I have. If you ask like you just did, I’ll happily tell you all kinds of stories.”
“So then, since you’ve traveled all over, Ark-san, you don’t happen to know a way to become a man, do you?”
Keel asked, seizing the opportunity, I say. Come to think of it, Keel’s female but wants to become male?
“You want to become a man?”
“I always thought I was a guy, but turns out I’m a girl!”
“Huh, is that so. Hmm… was that even permitted in this world?”
He seemed to have some idea, I say. Keel’s eyes were sparkling.

“It’s not that I don’t know a way, but I only teach or create things within the bounds of this world’s natural laws. If the materials and methods check out against this world’s principles, I’ll consider it for you.”
“Got it! Teach me all sorts of stuff again sometime, okay!”
Keel seemed satisfied with the answer, I say.
“Good thing that story wasn’t about me after all.”
“In your case, I think the problem is more that you tease people and crack jokes all the time.”
“Jokes are the essence of conversation. Say that, and aren’t you the one who’s always using roundabout phrasing?”
“That’s because being blunt isn’t always the right approach.”
“Somehow this is starting to sound like you could actually make Keel change sex…”
“If the method I know can be reproduced in this world, and it’s permitted—that’s about the extent of it, I’d say? Are you interested in changing sex too, Naofumi-kun?”
Ark asked Father with a somewhat provocative look in his eyes, I say.
“Why the hell would I need to change sex!”
“That’s right!”
“Indeed it is!”
Big Sister and the others chimed in in protest, siding with Father.
“Well, if there’s a possibility dangling in front of you, it might pique your curiosity, no?”
“More importantly… you clearly have some experience with this sort of thing. Come to think of it, that runaway dragon of ours went off traveling after getting teased by some female…”
Ah, that would be the original Filo-tan’s rival, indeed. The one that’s settled in the village, the one who rivals me—that’s Assistant’s little sister, a different matter entirely.
“Hahaha, seems like love’s complicated everywhere you go. Given Naofumi-kun’s domestic skills, if he were a woman, he’d probably be quite popular.”
Ho-kun made this joke at Father’s expense, I say.
“Indeed, if Father were a woman, back when I was still a fool, I might have looked into it more thoroughly to determine who was more righteous—him or the Crimson Swine, I say.”
The more you got to know Father, the more flavor he had—skilled at cooking, skilled at taking care of others, after all.
“Ugh… seriously, stop. That’s disgusting. I have zero intention of quitting being a man. In the end, even a god-slayer’s love-brained, huh.”
“Well, of course! I love my wife passionately! That’s my way of life!”
Ho-kun spread his wings and tail feathers wide with a flourish, showing off.
“Says the cheating bird who got abandoned by his wife. Well, I suppose experiencing all sorts of things in life is fun, isn’t it. Depending on the place, even gods fall in love, after all.”
“Well… that kind of story is rotting all over the place around here…”
Ark carried an air of being outside that circle, which struck me as a touch lonely somehow, I say.
“Oh my, but can’t liking or disliking someone happen regardless of gender?”
Older Sister hugged Ark from behind.
“That’s true. I do know that being together with someone is possible.”
With a mature response, Ark slipped smoothly out of Older Sister’s embrace.
“By the way, the cat here actually has two overprotective guardians. I keep in touch with them from time to time.”
“So they’re god-slayers too?”
“By definition, meaning they’re under me—yes, though it’s a bit hard to explain. It’s more accurate to say they’re beings made for my sake. Well, that’s enough talk for now—let’s clean up.”

Ark began clearing the dishes. Incidentally, Father didn’t do much cleaning up himself. The reason being that Big Sister liked to do it, and it made her terribly disappointed whenever Father did it on his own without asking.

“Ah, cleaning’s got someone in charge of it, so don’t overdo it. If you want to do something, tell me what you’d like to do. I hear you’re knowledgeable about alchemy, but… let’s put that matter on hold for now.”
“I know, I know.”
And with that, everyone parted ways for the time being.
